definitions.explanation: A bird living in its natural habitat, as opposed to domesticated or caged birds. Used in the context of birdwatching, nature conservation, and ecology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野鳥|やちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Observe wild birds in the park.

notes:
Refers to birds that live in the wild, as opposed to {飼|か}い{鳥|どり} (pet birds) or {家禽|かきん} (poultry).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野鳥|やちょう}{観察|かんさつ} (birdwatching)
- {野鳥|やちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (wild bird society)
- {野鳥|やちょう}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ (wild bird conservation)
- {野鳥|やちょう}⟦{図鑑|ずかん}→図鑑：00437_zukan⟧ (wild bird field guide)

The {日本野鳥|にほんやちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (Wild Bird Society of Japan) is a well-known conservation organization. Birdwatching ({野鳥|やちょう}{観察|かんさつ} or ⟦バードウォッチング→バードウォッチング：08814_baadowocchingu⟧) is a popular hobby in Japan.
